notes: litert-community/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct: kimi_linear_48b_a3b_mixed_int8_cpu_ekv4096.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct at revision e1df551a (MIT; a 27-layer hybrid decoder: 20 Kimi Delta Attention layers and 7 MLA layers, a dense first layer and 26 mixture-of-experts layers of 256 SiLU experts, 8 per token, plus one shared expert; no thinking mode), text in, text out; written in plain TFLite ops plus LiteRT's moe custom op (one per MoE layer, activation silu) by a graph writer for litert-torch (main 67f11e8): the routed experts int8 per channel (one scale per output row and expert) and every other weight fp32, the token table and the output layer included; the repo publishes it for the CPU; fp32 activations declared; context 4,096 tokens; signatures prefill_128, prefill_1024 and decode; a tokenizer.json converted from the source's tiktoken tokenizer. The moe op with SiLU is in two open LiteRT pull requests (#11192 GPU, #11188 XNNPACK); LiteRT-LM 0.19.2 from PyPI refuses it on both backends, as these two records show; the numbers of the LiteRT-LM built from source with LiteRT #11192 and #11188 (the repo card's Performance and Accuracy tables) are not records: that build has no frame here. Mac Studio rows only: the file is 55.29 GB and no phone was tried. Landed 2026-11-16: litert-community/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct is public and ungated (license mit, base_model moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct quantized, library_name litert-lm), upload commit f6b985ce (2026-11-13 08:18 JST), main b1a6fc381e (the card commit, 2026-11-15T20:14:29.000Z) at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of kimi_linear_48b_a3b_mixed_int8_cpu_ekv4096.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 55285913104 B.
